caption: Prologue | Wake | Reliving the explosion
art: An involuntary cry from a childhood trauma nightmare wakes Arin and disturbs the neighbor.
motion_prompt: A twelve-second intimate cinematic bedside shot in detailed painted realism, using the supplied image. Adult Arin remains LYING ON HIS PILLOW, shoulders supported by the bed, throughout. Preserve his face, chestnut hair, black undershirt and the same bedroom. He is trapped in the childhood memory of watching an explosion kill both his parents. The camera observes privately from beside the bed; he never addresses or looks into the camera. First, his closed eyelids tighten and his breathing catches, one hand unconsciously gripping the blanket. A terrified involuntary cry tears out of him WHILE HE IS STILL IN THE NIGHTMARE: he screams the single word Noooooooo! loudly, the vowel stretched for several seconds, raw, cracking and desperate with grief. His head pulls back INTO the pillow as if flinching from the explosion. The cry breaks unevenly with his breath rather than becoming a steady held note. His eyes snap open during the cry, unfocused and horrified; his shoulders make one startled recoil against the mattress. His arms stay low, clutching the bedding; he does not sit up, spread his arms, flex, gesture to an audience or adopt a pose. The scream collapses into ragged gasps and a trembling exhale. He stares toward the dark ceiling, then searches the familiar room with small frightened eye movements, slowly realizing the explosion was a memory. He stays awake and visibly shaken. Around second seven, angry pounding comes through the adjoining wall, and the unseen male neighbor shouts: Some of us work in the morning! Arin flinches at the knock, swallows, then answers weakly and breathlessly: So do I. The neighbor is never visible. The three spoken lines are only the terrified sustained Noooooooo!, the neighbor's exact sentence, and Arin's exact reply. Audio is synchronized and completely diegetic: scream, gasping breath, wall knocks and quiet room tone. A vulnerable involuntary trauma response, frightened grief, not rage or theatrical declamation. Locked camera, no cuts or zoom, no music. All dialogue is audible speech only. The picture stays entirely free of writing, subtitles, captions or graphics.

performance_direction: Sin rejected Clip 8 as a deliberate performance. Arin is involuntarily reliving witnessing both parents die in an explosion when he was a child. Cry begins while dreaming and carries into awakening; grief, fear and disorientation. He may remain lying down.
